name: Creepy (Rogue Genius Games)
body:
Bane: You suffer a -1 trait penalty when you use Bluff or Diplomacy on a character that is (or could be) sexually attracted to you, and a -1 trait penalty to the save DC of any language-dependent spell you cast on such characters or creatures.

Christina Stiles Presents Ultimate Options – Minor and Major Drawbacks, © 2013, Christina Stiles; Authors Christina Stiles, Robert Hudson, Jr., and Mike Welham
